page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc7.large is a compute-optimized instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is configured with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding 2.0 GB per core, and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a divergence between single-core and multi-core capabilities. The instance achieves average tier results in single-core metrics, such as a stress-ng single-core score of 1571.78 and a Geekbench single-core score of 1308.0. However, multi-core and memory-bound operations fall into the lower percentiles, with a multi-core Geekbench score of 1579.0 and memory bandwidth read-only large block speeds of 15.84 GB/sec. Cryptographic and compression tasks perform moderately, aided by hardware flags like AVX-512 and AES.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and high clock speed paired with a compact 4.0 GB memory footprint, this instance offers a cost-effective entry point for compute-bound workloads that do not require massive memory arrays or local storage. It is suitable for lightweight single-threaded applications, basic web serving, development environments, and microservices that benefit from dedicated CPU execution without the overhead of larger instance classes.
